propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail, surfacing as an INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets in the relation graph
The orphaned event-less directory is invisible to git (git cannot track empty directories) and persists in local clones, blocking plan reviews on entire epics until manually removed
The reducer must tolerate event-less ticket directories by skipping them with a warning rather than failing the snapshot, since such directories carry no information needed for relation snapshots

The writer continues creating the ticket directory before its first event to avoid concurrency races under the shared store model, so reader-side tolerance is the required fix for both new occurrences and existing broken clones
